subject: Retention TTL mapping & deletion acceptance criteria — evidence & delivery plan
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@clearbank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearbank.com
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: TTL -> Deletion evidence for SOC2 audit

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for taking this. As part of our SOC 2 in-scope evidence collection, our auditors are asking for a mapping between tenant TTL settings and the evidence we provide that a tenant's data was actually deleted (not just marked). Specifically they want:

- A clear mapping table: TTL value -> deletion workflow that runs -> artifact(s) produced.
- A small, redacted sample of the deletion audit log showing a tenant lifecycle deletion (timestamp + operation id + storage loci).
- Acceptance criteria your team uses to assert a deletion is complete (what checks do you run / expected states).
- An approximate delivery date for these artifacts.

Could you confirm what you can share and when? We can accept redacted samples. Our auditor reference is SEC-AUD-2026.

Appreciate it,
Priya Rao
Security Program Manager
ClearBank

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: artifact inventory + redaction notes

Quick internal note before we send to Priya:

Inventory of artifacts we can produce (redacted where required):
- Deletion manifest (CSV): lists operation_id, deletion_ts, storage_prefixes removed, snapshot_id if applicable. We will replace tenant_id with tenant_hash (SHA256 prefix) for samples.
- Object store deletion events: S3 delete markers / manifest entries (we can export event IDs and timestamps).
- KV cache eviction logs: ruling out residual in-memory artifacts (log lines + eviction confirmation).
- DB row tombstone audit: row-level audit record with op_type=DELETE (we will redact primary key values).

Acceptance criteria (summary):
- All three persistence layers show a deletion event for the operation_id: blobs/objects removed, DB row tombstone with audit record, and KV cache eviction event.
- No active pointers remain (index entries must not resolve to storage prefixes).
- Retention hold checks: operations blocked by legal hold will be flagged in the manifest.

Redaction plan: tenant_id -> tenant_hash; user identifiers -> user_hash; keep timestamps and operation ids intact. We will produce a 10-row sample for the auditor and a 100-row internal sample for ClearBank's security if needed under an NDA.

Delivery timeline:
- Draft TTL mapping CSV + 10-row redacted log: EOD next business day (2026-05-29 23:59 UTC).
- Full artifact packet (playbook + larger samples + runbook excerpt): 2026-06-03.

Attachments referenced: redacted_deletion_manifest.csv (sample), sample-deletion-log-snippet-20260527.txt

-Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
